contract: Use the active point-in-time C2/D2/E2 membership snapshot without per-universe parameter changes.
Allow an explicit OFF state. Market trend and breadth features may gate participation, but final thresholds are not selected in P1.
Require causal higher-timeframe trend agreement and minimum data sufficiency before ranking.
Rank eligible assets at the same causal snapshot using relative trend strength and persistence components.
Use one preregistered entry family: confirmed pullback or volatility-contraction breakout. Do not chase already extended moves.
Reject entries whose expected gross move does not dominate modeled round-trip cost plus uncertainty.
When valid signals compete, allocate in deterministic rank order subject to cash and concentration limits.
Signals formed on completed bars execute no earlier than the next eligible bar using the frozen cost model.
Use an immutable initial protective stop, thesis invalidation and a structural trailing exit. No fixed profit cap and no automatic 96-hour ceiling in P1.
